title: kbmon's sprint status gives one compact row per sprint, with the detail on request
goal: kbmon --status sprints prints one row per sprint, active first, each with a short name of at most 40 characters cut from its title at a word, its state, done of total, the percentage and the ETA, at most 100 characters; kbmon --status sprints --detail prints today's full lines, the items left among them, each by its short title; the sprint panel's rows use the same short name

run:
import json,os,re,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
long='The paid multi-agent runs measure concurrency, dedup, cache reuse, model choice, pack budget and kb tools'
SP=[{'id':'SP-aaaaaaaa','state':'approved','title':'An approved sprint','items':{'todo':3},'next':None,'next_title':None,'open':[],'done_at':[],'waiting':[]},
    {'id':'SP-bbbbbbbb','state':'active','title':long,'items':{'done':4,'todo':5,'doing':1},'next':'ST-cccccccc','next_title':'Next item title',
     'open':[{'id':'ST-cccccccc','title':'Next item title','status':'todo'},{'id':'ST-dddddddd','title':'An item in progress','status':'doing'}],
     'done_at':['2026-10-19T0%d:00:00Z'%h for h in range(1,6)],'waiting':[]},
    {'id':'SP-eeeeeeee','state':'planned','title':'A planned sprint','items':{'todo':2},'next':None,'next_title':None,'open':[],'done_at':[],'waiting':[]}]
snap={'schema':1,'taken':'2026-10-19T08:00:00Z','alerts':[],'panels':{'sprint':{'state':'ok','seconds':0.1,'data':{'sprints':SP,'source':'origin/main','behind':0,'landings':[]}},
      'host':{'state':'ok','seconds':0.1,'data':{'load':[1.0,1.0,1.0],'cores':8}}}}
f=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),'s.json');json.dump(snap,open(f,'w'))
r=lambda *a:s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*a,'--from-snapshot',f],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,env=dict(os.environ,COLUMNS='200')).stdout
st=r('--status','sprints');de=r('--status','sprints','--detail');pn=r('--once','--panel','sprint')
rows=[l for l in st.splitlines() if re.search(r'\b\d+/\d+\b',l)]
print(rows)
ok=(len(rows)==3 and 'The paid multi-agent runs' in rows[0] and '4/10' in rows[0] and '40%' in rows[0] and 'ETA' in rows[0]
    and all(len(l)<=100 for l in rows) and long not in st and 'left:' not in st and 'left:' in de and 'The paid multi-agent runs' in pn and long not in pn)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

clauses.clause: kbmon --status sprints prints one row per sprint, active first, each with a short name of at most 40 characters cut from its title at a word, its state, done of total, the percentage and the ETA, at most 100 characters
kbmon --status sprints --detail prints today's full lines, the items left among them, each by its short title
the sprint panel's rows use the same short name

Premise on origin/main 9cee34c, 2026-10-19: a --from-snapshot file with three sprints gives one 160-character row for the active sprint, its full title, a 'left:' line repeating item titles, the two others as separate prose lines and no --detail flag.
